decisions.title: MRMPO 2045 Socioeconomic Forecast Presentation
decisions.description: Summarizes the region’s approved 2020–2045 population, housing, and employment forecast, including county and small-area growth patterns, declining household size, forecast methodology, land-use inputs, and the forecast’s role in metropolitan transportation planning.
processing_notes: Original authoritative 18-page PDF preserved without modification.
Complete extracted text and map-heavy presentation content reviewed before inclusion.

decisions.title: MRMPO Regional Forecast by Data Analysis Subzone
decisions.description: Provides 2020 estimates and 2045 forecasts for population, households, housing units, group quarters, and employment by sector across 926 small-area Data Analysis Subzones in the five-county MRCOG model region.
processing_notes: Original authoritative workbook preserved without modification.
Workbook structure, 24 fields, 927 rows including headers, and representative records reviewed before inclusion.

decisions.title: MRMPO Bernalillo County Forecast by Data Analysis Subzone
decisions.description: Extracts the 2020 estimates and 2045 population, housing, and employment forecasts for 671 Bernalillo County Data Analysis Subzones, providing the most focused downloadable small-area dataset for Albuquerque and nearby county communities.
processing_notes: Original authoritative workbook preserved without modification.
Workbook structure, 24 fields, 672 rows including headers, and representative records reviewed before inclusion.

decisions.title: MRMPO Data Analysis Subzone Data Dictionary
decisions.description: Defines the geography, population, household, housing-unit, group-quarters, and employment fields used in MRMPO’s 2025 regional and county forecast workbooks, including the industries assigned to basic, retail, and service employment.
processing_notes: Original authoritative two-page PDF preserved without modification.
Complete extracted text reviewed before inclusion.
